items.description: Modern browsers supports web components standards without any of the polyfills listed below. The only notable exception is that customized built-in elements are rejected by WebKit (Safari).
items.title: Polyfills

items.description: The articles below represent a long story of the Web Components specifications on the way towards the standardization. Some of them refer to earlier, so-called "v0" Shadow DOM and Custom Elements specs, and abandoned HTML Imports spec. These materials are here for historical reasons only, they are grouped by years and listed in chronological order.
